jobSearch.title: Job search
jobSearch.intro: Describe the work you want. Turn your request into focused searches across connected job sources, including LinkedIn listings when available.
jobSearch.country_hint: Leave this automatic to use the country in your request.
jobSearch.sources_hint: Choose where to search. Availability depends on the connected providers.
jobSearch.sources_error: We couldn’t load the search sources.
jobSearch.unconfigured_body: Job search will be available when a source is connected. You can still browse your existing job matches.
jobSearch.start_title: Your next role starts with a search
jobSearch.start_body: Describe your next role above, then select Search Job. You’ll see the searches used, the roles found, and what still needs checking in each posting.
jobSearch.no_sources: Select at least one available source.
jobSearch.error_body: Please try again. If the problem continues, choose another available source.
jobSearch.rate_limited: You’ve reached the search limit. Wait a moment, then try again.
jobSearch.empty_title: No roles found for this search
jobSearch.empty_body: Try a broader job title, another location, or fewer filters.
jobSearch.partial: Some sources couldn’t complete the search. The results below are from the sources that responded.
jobSearch.all_failed: No source could complete this search. Please try again or select another source.
jobSearch.description_missing: A description wasn’t included. Open the original posting for the role’s full details.
jobSearch.freshness_note: Posting dates are supplied by the source. Open the original posting to confirm the role is still available.
jobSearch.request_label: What kind of job are you looking for?
jobSearch.request_placeholder: Find senior frontend roles in Taipei or remote in Taiwan. I use React and TypeScript, prefer product teams, and want postings from the past week.
jobSearch.request_hint: Include the role, location, skills, and preferences that matter to you.
jobSearch.request_invalid: Describe the role you want in at least 10 characters.
jobSearch.agent_pending: Planning your search and checking connected sources…
jobSearch.search_stopped: Search stopped. You can update your request and search again.
jobSearch.linkedin_hint: Only show roles with LinkedIn provenance. Coverage depends on the selected sources; this search does not cover every LinkedIn listing.
jobSearch.overrides_hint: These settings override your request. Leave them automatic to use the details you describe.
jobSearch.plan_hint: These queries and filters were used to find the roles below.
jobSearch.plan_unverified: Check these in the original posting
jobSearch.plan_unverified_hint: These preferences could not be reliably checked from the available job data.
jobSearch.query_failed: This query couldn’t finish. Results from completed queries are still shown.
jobSearch.query_limited: This query reached the search limit. Results from completed queries are still shown.
jobSearch.agent_unavailable: The search agent is temporarily unavailable. Please try again; no search results have been generated.
jobSearch.linkedin_empty: No LinkedIn listings were returned by the selected sources. Try broader criteria or turn off LinkedIn-only search.
jobSearch.entry_hint: Describe your next role and search connected job sources.

jobSearchApi.title: Job search, ready to connect.
jobSearchApi.intro: Bring structured job search into your product through one API, with source attribution and provider status in every response.
jobSearchApi.contract_body: Search by role, location, remote work, posting date, and source. Results use a shared format for salary, company, application links, and provenance.
jobSearchApi.reliability_body: Inspect provider status and partial results. A source failure is visible, so your integration can decide whether to retry.
jobSearchApi.access_body: Create a named key for your server and revoke it from your account. Keep keys on your backend, outside browser code.
jobSearchApi.quickstart_body: Create a key, store it as an environment variable on your server, and send this request to your RoboApply origin.
jobSearchApi.example_note: Replace ROBOAPPLY_ORIGIN with your deployment URL and ROBOAPPLY_JOB_SEARCH_KEY with your API key.
jobSearchApi.response_body: Read jobs for normalized results and meta.providers for source outcomes. Check meta.partial before treating a response as complete. Use the OpenAPI document for field definitions and error responses.
jobSearchApi.terms_body: Available sources depend on server configuration and provider entitlements. Provider usage terms still apply to job data, including storage and redistribution. This endpoint does not submit applications.
jobSearchApi.keys_intro: Connect your server to RoboApply job search. Each key belongs to your account and can be revoked independently.
jobSearchApi.keys_empty_body: Create a named key to connect your first integration.
jobSearchApi.keys_error: We couldn’t load your API keys.
jobSearchApi.create_error: We couldn’t create the key. Please try again.
jobSearchApi.revoke_error: We couldn’t revoke the key. Please try again.
jobSearchApi.secret_body: This is the only time the full key is shown. Copy it to a secure location before dismissing it.
jobSearchApi.copy_error: Copy didn’t work. Select the key and copy it manually.
jobSearchApi.revoke_confirm: Revoke this API key? Integrations using it will stop working.
